sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
The NSW Department of Education's Calendar for Cultural Diversity provides annual dates and information on celebrations, commemorations, national and international days, religious observances and key events relevant to NSW public school staff, students and their families.
Sponsors of the department’s Calendar for Cultural Diversity can:
- demonstrate a visible commitment to strengthening and supporting social cohesion for all NSW school communities
- contribute towards promoting intercultural understanding, awareness and diversity
- support harmonious multicultural and multilingual communities across NSW.
Sponsors will receive:
- logo recognition on the calendar front page (printed next to the Department of Education NSW Government Waratah)
- logo recognition on the calendar webpage
- logo recognition on a calendar internal page
- logo recognition on teacher planner and digital background
- invitation to the 2027 calendar launch
- tickets to Schools Spectacular
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The department is seeking sponsors to support the 2027 Calendar for Cultural Diversity financially or with in-kind contributions:
Ways to sponsor
- Gold Major Sponsor (3) - $25,000+ GST (exclusive category)
- Silver Sponsors (6) - $8,000 + GST (limited category)
- Bronze Sponsors - $3,000 + GST (open category)
- Value-in-kind Sponsors- Distribution and printing partner The department is seeking sponsors to support the printing and distribution of the calendar to all Public Schools financially or with in-kind contributions.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
Expressions of interest may be submitted:
- via the online Sponsorship EOI - 2027 Calendar for Cultural Diversity response form ( https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/5kVug7sGDv)
- on buy.nsw.gov.au
- in an email to a department contact (see attached EOI)
Please note:
- as this is not a procurement opportunity, scheme membership (SCM0020) * Information and technology and (SCM0256) * Construction is not a mandatory requirement.
- this is a request for sponsors for the2027 Calendar for Cultural Diversity - we are not able to respond to requests to supply to the department, or any other procurement-related enquiries. For all enquiries relating to supplying to the department please visit:  https://education.nsw.gov.au/about-us/supplying-to-us
